item.title: U.S. imposes sweeping sanctions on International Criminal Court
item.description: The U.S. has announced sanctions against the International Criminal Court, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio vowing to dismantle the world's only permanent war crimes tribunal.
item.content:encoded: The U.S. has announced sanctions against the International Criminal Court, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio vowing to dismantle the world's only permanent war crimes tribunal.

item.title: Week in Politics: Hegseth's livestream backlash; Greece ambassador Guilfoyle scandal
item.description: Bipartisan blowback on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's plans to livestream a military execution, plus a scandal involving Kimberly Guilfoyle, the US Ambassador to Greece.

item.title: On the ground in Ohio's 9th District: The battleground shaping next month's midterms
item.description: Ohio is a critical battleground in next month's midterms elections. NPR's Scott Simon traveled to the state's 9th Congressional District to hear from voters about their priorities.

item.title: After losing ground with Latino voters, Democrats are turning to influencers for help
item.description: Democrats are hoping to win back Latino voters who have soured on both parties. They hope Latino content creators will bridge the gap.

item.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
item.description: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.

item.title: Why mailing a ballot close to Election Day may get it rejected for a late postmark
item.description: If you're using the U.S. Postal Service to return a ballot close to Election Day, officials recommend getting it postmarked at a post office to avoid getting caught up in mail processing changes.

item.title: 25 years later an Afghan couple looks back at the invasion
item.description: Twenty-five years ago this week, the U.S. invaded Afghanistan. For StoryCorps, one Afghan couple offers an account of their experience after the invasion and eventual U.S. withdrawal.
